title: carex nigra subsp. juncea
intro: Carex nigra subsp. juncea, commonly known as Black Sedge or Juncea Sedge, is a subspecies of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Carex nigra subsp. juncea include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of urinary issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
